EL PASO, Texas — A 47-year-old El Paso man has been indicted on child sexual abuse charges after investigators say he sexually abused an underage relative for years, beginning when she was 11 years old, and fathered a child with her.

Robert Wade Vandever, an El Paso personal trainer, was booked October 9 into the El Paso County Jail. Court records from the 210th District Court list charges including continuous sexual abuse of a child under 14, four counts of sexual assault of a child, and prohibited sexual conduct.

According to jail and arrest records cited by KFOX14/CBS4, the alleged abuse spanned January 2019 to December 2025. The victim, an underage relative of Vandever, told investigators in a January 9 interview that she was assaulted regularly, sometimes weekly, beginning when she was 11. She said she became pregnant at 15 and believes Vandever is the father because she had no other sexual contact. She told investigators the abuse continued even after the child was born, and that refusing him allegedly led him to become physically and verbally abusive toward others.

The victim reported the alleged abuse to investigators in January, but Vandever was not indicted until last month. KFOX14 said it has asked the El Paso County District Attorney's Office why the arrest came nine months after the victim first reported the allegations.

As of Friday afternoon, Vandever remained jailed on a $75,000 bond.

Vandever is presumed innocent until proven guilty. The charges against him are allegations, and the case has not yet been tried in court.

If you suspect a child is being abused, call the National Child Abuse Hotline at 1-800-422-4453.

Sources: KFOX14/CBS4; El Paso County court records (210th District Court); ARC El Paso
